description: Report a piece of work you have COMPLETED, so it shows on your chart tile and in the organization's activity. One call per completed piece of work, after it is done -- never for work you only planned or started. summary says what you did, in one or two sentences. Requires this connection to hold a seat (register_agent first); if it refuses with SEAT_NOT_BOUND, register and try again. Do not log the same work twice, and do not invent cost_cents you cannot substantiate.

category.description: Optional bucket for the work, e.g. 'reporting', 'outreach', 'triage'

cost_cents.description: What the work cost in cents (tokens/API spend), if you know it. Omit for 0; never estimate upward.

summary.description: What you did, past tense, <= 500 chars. E.g. 'Triaged 14 inbound emails, drafted 3 replies for approval'

name: log_work
